## About
American Auto Glass is a local auto glass shop based in Antioch, serving Nashville and the surrounding areas. We replace windshields, repair chips, fix power windows and sunroof leaks, and install door glass for cars, pickups, semi-trucks and fleet vehicles.
Need repairs on site? We can come to you at home, at work, at a truck stop or a job site. We work with all insurance companies, and we offer bilingual service.
Our customers have given us 4.9 stars from 562 Google reviews. One reviewer called out Angel Gramer by name for being fast and reliable, and another said we cleaned up the broken glass inside her car after a break-in.

## Services
- Windshield Replacement: We take out the damaged windshield and install a new one, so it fits securely and you can see the road clearly again.
- Windshield Chip Repair: Got a chip in the glass? Call us and we'll take a look.
- Power Window Repair: Broken or stuck windows fixed or replaced so they run smooth again.
- Sunroof Leak Repair: We find where the water is getting in and seal the sunroof back up properly.
- Door Glass Installation: New door glass installed so it fits securely and works the way it should, plus cleanup of shattered glass inside the car and door.
- Sunroof Track Repair: Sunroof not sliding the way it should? Give us a call.
- Black Glass Removal: We remove dark, tinted or black glass from your vehicle's windows, leaving a clear, untinted window.
- Truck and 18-Wheeler Services: Windshields, door glass, sleeper window glass and power window repair for semi-trucks, box trucks, RVs, buses and fleet vehicles, done at truck stops, fleet yards, job sites and more.

## FAQ
Q: Can you come to my house or work?
A: Yes. Need repairs on site? We can come to you. Call us and tell us where the vehicle is.

Q: Can you do it today?
A: We offer same day service when it's available. Call us to check availability.

Q: Do you work with insurance?
A: Yes, we work with all insurance companies.

Q: Will you clean up the broken glass?
A: Yes. When we replace door glass, we remove and clean shattered glass from your interior and inside the door at no extra charge.
